name: Academy-Attendance-App
description: Staff & Faculty Attendance Management System for KIPS MGP M Academy — built with Next.js 14, TypeScript & Supabase

paragraphs: A web-based attendance and leave management system built for KIPS MGP M Academy, allowing teachers and staff to mark daily attendance status (full-day off or short leave), while giving the principal complete visibility into staff records through a centralized dashboard.

Managing staff attendance manually through registers is slow and hard to track over time. This system digitizes the process — staff can log their leave requests in seconds from their phone or laptop, and the principal gets a real-time, organized view of who's off, who's on short leave, and full historical records per staff member.
features: Simple sign-up with role selection (Teacher or Staff Member)
Teachers additionally select the subject they teach
One-tap Mark Off with a required reason
